title: Stefan-Boltzmann limit
references: Kittel, C. and Kroemer, H., Thermal Physics, 2nd ed., W. H. Freeman (1980)
Planck, M., The Theory of Heat Radiation, P. Blakiston's Son & Co. (1914)
validity_domain: Power per unit area emitted into the half space by the surface of a body at uniform absolute temperature T, in vacuum or a non-absorbing medium.
limitations: The bound is reached by a black body; a real surface has emissivity at most 1 (Kirchhoff's law at thermal equilibrium), so its flux is lower
Total emitted flux over all wavelengths; absorbed or reflected ambient radiation is not counted
Far-field, macroscopic surfaces: not valid at distances or sizes comparable to the thermal wavelength

variables.T: Absolute temperature of the emitting surface
